# Independent MSE vectors

Generated by `mse_vectors.py` with Python pow, hashlib and textbook RC4.
The fixed modulus is the MSE modulus, not the Oakley group-1 modulus.
Keys are bytes 1..20 and 21..40; wire key is 20 bytes of 0x11.
Both public values have maximum legal 512-byte padding.
